messages:
Sara Gupta: FYI – BlueMesa sent their RFI + capability matrix this morning. They want: 1) short written answers to the security checklist, 2) a POC timeline (2-week eval + integration week), and 3) a pricing estimate for Dedicated vs Hosted. I attached the RFI PDF and the matrix they filled out. Can owners please drop quick answers/notes here so I can stitch a single response pack by EOD.

Mike Chen: Got it. I'll grab pricing numbers. Quick question – are we planning to propose a mixed Dedicated + Hosted fallback for latency-sensitive endpoints? That changes burst/add-on pricing. :thinking_face:

Jordan Lee: @Mike yes, recommend Dedicated for steady throughput + Hosted fallback for peak burst. I'll paste a minimal capability table snippet we can drop into the RFI.

Jordan Lee: ```
Feature,Dedicated,Hosted
Throughput (tokens/s),>10k,variable
SLO (p95 latency),<120ms,~200-500ms
Data residency,Customer VPC,Redwood regions
Encryption (at rest),KMS support,KMS + managed
```

Elaine Park: Security checklist status: I've answered all items except HSM ownership and FedRAMP status (BlueMesa asked specific controls). For HSM we support customer-managed KMS + HSM-backed keys via BYOK; I'll upload the SAML/KMS diagram and an excerpt from our SOC2 report (redacted).

Elaine Park: Uploads: blue_rfi_answers_Sara_requested.docx, redacted_soc2_excerpt.pdf, kms_hsm_design.png

Mike Chen: Pricing draft: base Dedicated commit (4xA100 equiv) + burst Hosted -- rough numbers below, still need finance signoff.

Mike Chen: ```
Option A - Dedicated (monthly commit): $65k/mo (sustained)
Option B - Hosted fallback (per-token burst): $0.0009/token
POC discount: 50% credits for first 2 weeks
Additional HSM/KMS integration services: one-time $12k
```

Amber (SalesOps): BlueMesa expects a POC start next Mon if we can provide credentials and a short onboarding runbook by Friday. Who can own env provisioning + a test dataset sync?

Jordan Lee: I can spin up a dedicated sandbox cluster and drop the sample dataset. Need BlueMesa engineer email for access.

Sara Gupta: @Elaine can you confirm the redacted SOC2 PDF is safe to share with this prospect? Also add a one-paragraph response on data handling (retention/ingress/egress) we can paste into the RFI.

Elaine Park: Confirmed safe to share (redacted CI). One-paragraph blurb: "Redwood Inference processes customer inputs transiently for inference. We do not retain input payloads beyond configured cache TTLs unless explicitly enabled for logging or analytics; all stored artifacts are encrypted with customer-managed or Redwood-managed KMS per the customer's configuration. Access is audited and role-restricted." Feel free to copy verbatim.

RFP Bot: Reminder: please attach capability matrix CSV and single PDF answer bundle in the RFP response zip. Use naming: BlueMesa_RFI_Answers_{date}.zip

Mike Chen: I'll assemble the capability CSV and pricing sheet. Expect two files by 17:00 PT.

Amber (SalesOps): Also ask legal for the POC BAU: quick note – standard MSA addendum for POC + data processing addendum. I'll ping legal now. :email:

Sara Gupta: Thanks team — if we can get attachments + one-paragraph pieces in here, I'll merge and send. If any blocker (FedRAMP/HSM) remains after Elaine's uploads, call it out and we'll propose mitigations (timeline/third-party attestation).

Jordan Lee: No blockers on infra side. I'll include sample CLI commands for onboarding in the pack: ```
redwoodctl provision --env blue-mesa-sandbox --model gpt-optimized --commit 4
redwoodctl upload-data --env blue-mesa-sandbox --bucket s3://blue-mesa-sandbox/sample
```

Elaine Park: Uploaded final answers doc: BlueMesa_RFI_Answers_2026-03-23.docx

Mike Chen: Uploaded pricing_sheet_1801234567.xlsx and capability_matrix_1801234567.csv

Amber (SalesOps): Legal responded: will provide POC addendum template by EOD.

Sara Gupta: Perfect. I'll bundle and send to BlueMesa after legal + finance sign-off. Will post the sent copy here. :thumbsup:
